name: The New Breed
caption: The tag team of Enforcer and Nightmare, contesting for the OWA Tag Team Championship shot on the promotion's weekly InterNet Wrestling Pro broadcasts.

tenures.note: Lost non-title outings to Freddy Fever and Major Threat on 6 and 14 December 1995, the second billed as a title-shot eliminator.

identity.note: A shared team name only; no roster, date, or storyline overlap with the other held wings' own New Breed.

name: The Family
caption: A villainous six-member stable -- Ricky Blood and Big Dawg Rich on the InterNet side, Pretty Boy Monty, Devastator, Rocket, and Phantom on the INN side -- who announced their intent to capture every belt in the OWA.

tenures.note: Declared its intent to sweep the OWA, INN, InterNet, and OWA Tag Team titles; its members wrestled individually rather than as an in-ring unit across the held record.

identity.note: A shared stable name only; no roster, date, or storyline overlap with the other held wing's own Family.

name: Femme Fatales
caption: The tag team of Traci Lane and Denise Duncan, who declared themselves the OWA's coming dominant force at the close of 1995.

tenures.note: Announced the pairing in an in-character promo on 14 December 1995; its members wrestled individually rather than as an in-ring unit across the held record.

name: The Nightmare Express
caption: The tag team of Anthony Hazard and Mr. Excitement, formed at the close of 1995.

tenures.source: A recurring "OWA Spotlight" column, 26-27 December 1995 and 6 January 1996 (rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy)
tenures.note: Formed in a recurring OWA Spotlight column; no match of the pairing is recorded in the held record.

name: The Extremists
caption: The tag team of Danny Maxx and Johnny Blades, OWA Tag Team Champions and 1996 Achievement Award winners for Best Tag Team.

identity.note: A shared ring name only; no roster, date, or storyline overlap found with the other held entity.

name: The Chiefs
caption: The tag team of Mike Mustang and Johnny Stallion, contenders for the OWA Tag Team Championship through 1996.

name: Brawlers, Inc.
caption: The tag team of Sabin Figaro and MegaDiesel, debuting in mid-1996 and winning the OWA Tag Team Championship by that October.

name: Sumwhatta-Powers
caption: An enhancement tag team fed to the debuting Brawlers, Inc. in mid-1996.

name: The Elite
caption: A stable of Anthony Hazard, The Shocker, and The Extremists managed by Sir Goodwin, formed in spring 1996 after Hazard's alliance with the Femme Fatale.

tenures.source: OWA Championship Wrestling, 13 March 1996 (dated by internal evidence to April 1996)

identity.note: A shared ring name only; no roster, date, or storyline overlap found with the other held entity.

name: The Evil Empire
caption: A stable revealed on 5 January 1997 when a supposed rivalry between Mr. America and Asian Invasion turned out to be a work.

tenures.note: Formed on-air when Mr. America, Asian Invasion, and Chaos revealed a weeks-long angle and beat down Freddy Fever together after an OWA TV Championship match.

identity.note: A shared stable name only; no roster, date, or storyline overlap found with either other held entity.

name: MP Inc
caption: A stable fronted by Masked Plague that challenged for the OWA Trio Tag Team Championship at Crime Spree.

name: The Crew
caption: A stable holding the OWA Trio Tag Team Championship, joined by Virgo after he won the OWA TV Championship at Crime Spree.

tenures.note: Virgo joined the same night he won the OWA TV Championship, in the Finale.
